author: claude
text:
docs+repo: disk-first rewrite and CLAUDE.md -> AGENTS.md symlink

Two changes that had been left uncommitted on main, now applied
through the proper worktree flow:

- docs/PRINCIPLES.md: rewrite the "Disk first" state list to lean on
  chat-oriented vocabulary already defined in TAXONOMY.md (messages,
  responses, tool calls).
- CLAUDE.md: symlink to AGENTS.md so Claude Code reads the repo's
  single AGENTS source.
